notes: The DAAD page states application periods for the summer semester (1 October - 28 February) and winter semester (15 April - 31 August) valid for applicants from all countries, but these are application windows without a year and without a specific non-EU deadline; they could not be turned into an intake because the pages give no dated deadline for non-EU applicants. The university's own deadlines page says there are no special deadlines for foreign applicants but gives dates without years. There is a tuition fee exception: the Italian 'IMR International Medical Research' programme is not relevant here; the DAAD page for this programme states tuition fees per semester None and the university page for international students states no tuition fees in Rheinland-Pfalz, so the tuition is 0 EUR per year. The main university page (hs-kl.de/en/studying/application/apply-from-abroad) lists the language requirements for this programme as a general table that includes the 'Bachelor & Master Mechanical Engineering' entry; the DAAD page also confirms B2 English. The statement 'There are no minimum language requirements. However, a basic knowledge of German is recommended.' follows each language block, but the B2 English requirement is stated separately in the same block, so the B2 rule is included.
